title: Release notes sequencing and partner enablement for dedicated reservation tiers and new APAC instance types
creator: Priya Shah
project: Dedicated Capacity: APAC + New Instance SKUs
description: Goal: Coordinate sequencing of release notes, partner enablement materials, and channel communications for the March dedicated-capacity launch that includes: 1) new APAC regions (ap-sg, ap-seoul) and 2) new instance types (GCP T4i-like small/high-memory SKU). This ticket covers cross-functional orchestration between PM, Engineering, Developer Relations, Solutions, Sales, Legal, and Marketing to ensure: embargoed release notes are accurate, marketplace entitlements are updated, partner-facing enablement decks and FAQs are ready, and support playbooks are published before customer-facing announcements. We will stagger release notes across channels to minimize confusion: internal release to Sales & Support -> partner preview -> public docs/API/changelog -> marketplace catalog updates.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering has merged runtime + infra PRs and published runtime release notes with exact instance names and SKU limits
Marketplace entries (AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace) updated with SKU and pricing metadata and validated by partner ops
Support playbook and triage runbook published in Confluence and a 30-min walkthrough recorded for on-call
Partner enablement slide deck and one-pager shipped to partners and Solutions team with clear migration guidance
Release notes sequencing plan approved by Legal and Marketing and dry-run comms executed internally
checklist: Confirm final instance naming with Eng (deadline: 2026-03-05)
Lock reservation tier labels (Commit-1m, Commit-12m, Flex-Burst) and SKU codes
Create channel-specific release notes: internal, partner, public, marketplace
Prepare migration FAQ and a low-latency troubleshooting checklist for Solutions Engineers
Schedule two 30-min enablement calls: Sales APAC and Enterprise SEs
Coordinate embargo windows and feature flags with infra ops
Validate billing/test-accounts for each reservation tier (billing QA)

risks_mitigation: Risk: Marketplace SKU metadata mismatch delays public listing -> Mitigation: push public doc release but hold marketplace publish; provide temporary guidance for partners to use direct API until fixed
Risk: Pricing or quota changes post-announcement -> Mitigation: include explicit migration policy and timeline in release notes and announce price-effective date
Risk: Support load spike during first 72 hours -> Mitigation: rotate additional SEs, create canned responses, and publish triage flow in Support Slack #support-dedicated
rollout_plan: T-7 days: Internal release notes + all stakeholder sync; enable feature flags in staging
T-3 days: Partner preview via encrypted email + dedicated webinar; marketplace ops notified
Launch day (T0): Public docs, API spec bump, console SKU listing; monitor dashboard (SLO & error rates)
T+1 day: Marketplace publish (if billing QA passes); send post-launch partner summary
T+7 days: Collect early feedback, prioritize P1 issues for hotfixes or rollback decisions
